title: A190302 — a(n) < 6 for all n, Frohlich conjecture (Lean 4)
description: theorem A190302: for every n >= 1, the smallest h >= 1 such that the decimal expansion of n*h starts with 1 satisfies 1 <= a(n) < 6. Proves the OEIS conjecture (Felix Frohlich, 2018, verified to n = 10022141) via the exact formula a(n) = 1 if the leading digit of n is 1, else a(n) = ceil(10^(d+1)/n) with d = floor(log10 n); bound ceil(10^(d+1)/(2*10^d)) = 5. Bound asserted without proof by Greathouse 2011 on A187285; first written proof and first formalization. Standard axioms only; zero native_decide.
